newsitem.title: DUBAI: UPS says Mideast cargo fine despite strike.
newsitem.headline: UPS says Mideast cargo fine despite strike.

text.p: A strike by United Parcel Service employees in the United States was not affecting the courier company's Middle East business, UPS said on Tuesday.

"We can confidently confirm that all UPS services for our Middle East customers remain unaffected by the recent strike action in the United States, with contingencies in place to maintain these service levels," UPS Middle East regional director Damian Bond said in a statement.
The statement said UPS expects the action to have limited impact on international traffic to the United States, which would receive top priority in delivery scheduling there.
"It's business as usual for all Middle East, European and African countries," it said.
The strike entered its second day on Tuesday with no talks scheduled between management and the Teamsters union.
